messages:
sam_sales: Heads up — HorizonBank returned the SIG v2 and marked Q30-Q33 as blockers. They want per-question artifacts and a plain-language sentence for each. Can we split?

rachel_se: I can take Q30 (tenant isolation) and Q33 (network segmentation). I'll need the redacted tenancy diagram and a sanitized Envoy snippet.

tom_security: I'll take Q31 (KMS/key rotation) and Q32 (encryption at rest/in-transit). I have a short rotation policy excerpt and an encryption summary.

lynne_ps: I'll pull SOC2 excerpts and a small dataflow blurb. Also can attach a POC screenshot showing tenant filters.

artifactbot: File uploaded: <https://files.redwood.internal/tenancy_diagram_horizon_v1.pdf|tenancy_diagram_horizon_v1.pdf> (512KB)

rachel_se: For the Envoy example, Horizon asked for YAML. I'll paste a sanitized snippet and then push to the shared folder.

rachel_se: ```yaml
# sanitized per-tenant routing
virtual_hosts:
  - name: tenant-xyz
    routes:
      - match: /tenant/xyz/*
        cluster: rwinf-tenant-xyz
```

tom_security: For KMS, reference `kms_rotation_excerpt_2026.md` and note HSM-backed storage. Also add BYOK note: supported in Private with customer-managed keys via KMS APIs.

lynne_ps: Uploaded SOC2 excerpt and dataflow note: <https://files.redwood.internal/soc2_horizon_excerpt.pdf|soc2_horizon_excerpt.pdf>, <https://files.redwood.internal/dataflow_horizon.md|dataflow_horizon.md>

artifactbot: File uploaded: <https://files.redwood.internal/poc_tenant_filter_horizon.png|poc_tenant_filter_horizon.png> (145KB)

sam_sales: Please post final filenames you'll add to the bundle and a 1-2 sentence plain-English blurb for each question so I can paste into the SIG answers. Aiming to send by EOD tomorrow.

rachel_se: Filenames: `/shared/sales-horizon/tenancy_diagram_redacted.pdf`, `/shared/sales-horizon/envoy_tenant_snippet.yaml`
rachel_se: Plain English (Q30/Q33): "Each tenant's requests are routed using tenant-specific proxy routes that map to isolated runtime clusters and separate network segments; proxy rules and network policies prevent cross-tenant traffic."

tom_security: Filenames: `/shared/sales-horizon/kms_rotation_excerpt.md`, `/shared/sales-horizon/encryption_summary.txt`
tom_security: Plain English (Q31/Q32): "Keys are stored in an HSM-backed KMS with automated rotation; data is encrypted at rest and in transit using standard TLS and disk encryption mechanisms. Private deployments support BYOK."

lynne_ps: Filenames: `/shared/sales-horizon/soc2_excerpt.pdf`, `/shared/sales-horizon/dataflow_summary.md`, `/shared/sales-horizon/poc_tenant_filter.png`

sam_sales: Great. Two small asks: 1) ensure no hostnames/account IDs in snippets, 2) add one-line caption to the screenshot describing what the image shows.

rachel_se: Will redact hostnames and add caption to the screenshot.
tom_security: Added rotation cadence line: "Rotation: 90 days (automated), HSM-backed; audit logs retained per retention policy."

sam_sales: Thanks — I'll package into `/shared/sales-horizon/horizon_sig_bundle.zip` and send after a quick review.
